note.title: Assistant instructions
note.hint: Included in every chat. Good for preferences like answer style or preferred language.

tools.hint: Tools you turn off are hidden from the assistant.

mcp.noTools: This service doesn’t offer any tools.

content.title: Content
content.hint: Suggestions are only created when a chat expresses a clear long-term preference or reusable rule; routine Q&A stays quiet. Nothing takes effect until confirmed.

group.pendingHint: Not injected into chats until confirmed
group.activeHint: Injected as standing rules and background preferences

memory.empty: No memories yet. Preferences you confirm in chats appear here.

diff.keepPin: Pinned status will be kept after replacing.

interest.empty: No interest tags yet. Add one above, or turn a pending memory into an interest.

exportFold.hint: Export to a JSON file to keep a copy. Clearing permanently deletes all memories and asks for confirmation first.
exportFold.clearMessage: Delete every memory? This can’t be undone.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.hint: Only affects the order in Focus; articles are never hidden.
ranking.boostHint: Boosts visible articles related to interests you’ve confirmed.
ranking.rerankHint: When off, Focus is ordered only by time and rule scores.
ranking.note: Interests only affect the score and order of visible articles; they never undo rule-based hiding.
